# J K Fertilizers

> J K Fertilizers is a B2B manufacturer of organic fertilizers, base granules, and coated granules in Anand, Gujarat, India. Specializing in FCO-approved Organic Manure, PROM, PDM, and Mycorrhiza granules since 2006.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://jkfertilizers.com/): Official website for J K Fertilizers, organic fertilizer manufacturer in Gujarat, India.
- [About Us](https://jkfertilizers.com/about): Company history, mission, leadership under founder Akash Dadhania, and manufacturing standards in Vasad, Gujarat.
- [Company History](https://jkfertilizers.com/history): Milestones and timeline from 2006 founding to modern 700 MT/day processing facilities in Vasad, Gujarat.
- [Products Catalog](https://jkfertilizers.com/products): Complete range of FCO-approved organic fertilizers, base granules, and customized coated granules.
- [Services](https://jkfertilizers.com/services): B2B manufacturing, granule technology, infrastructure leasing, custom packaging, and job work solutions.
- [Portfolio](https://jkfertilizers.com/portfolio): Proven track record of agricultural products and 150+ client partnerships.
- [Commitment](https://jkfertilizers.com/commitment): Dedication to sustainability, environmental stewardship, and farmer prosperity.
- [Blog & Insights](https://jkfertilizers.com/blog): Industry analysis, B2B procurement advice, and agricultural science insights.
- [Contact](https://jkfertilizers.com/contact): Direct contact details, plant address in Vasad, Anand, and inquiry form for bulk orders.
- [Pricing & Commercials](https://jkfertilizers.com/pricing.md): B2B pricing model, volume tiers, MOQ, payment terms, and delivery info.

## Organic Fertilizer Products

- [Organic Manure](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/organic-manure): FCO-approved organic manure enriched with composted organic matter and humic substances.
- [PROM (Phosphate Rich Organic Manure)](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/prom): Organic bio-phosphorus fertilizer replacing chemical DAP and SSP for root growth.
- [PDM (Potash Derived from Molasses)](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/pdm): Organic potassium fertilizer supporting crop vigor and water stress tolerance.
- [Mycorrhiza Biofertilizer](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/mycorrhiza-granules-biofertilizers): VAM-infused granules that expand root surface area and improve nutrient absorption.
- [Customized Coated Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/customized-coated-granules): Base granules with high absorption capacity for custom bio-fertilizers and micronutrient coatings.
- [Coated Base Granules Bio NPK](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/coated-base-granules-bio-npk): Triple-action biological coating delivering balanced N, P, and K with bio-agents.
- [Coated Base Granules Mycorrhiza](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/coated-base-granules-mycorrhiza): Mineral-mycorrhiza blend ensuring living fungal spores reach the root zone safely.
- [Customized Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/customized-base-granules): Tailored carrier matrix engineered from dolomite, gypsum, and compost formulations.
- [Pancharatna Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/pancharatna-base-granules): 5-in-1 multi-nutrient foundation providing balanced macro and micronutrients.
- [Organic Carbon Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/organic-carbon-base-granules): High organic matter carrier revitalizing depleted soils and improving microbial activity.
- [Humic Based Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/humic-based-granules): Humic and fulvic acid enriched granules for root stimulation.
- [Enriched Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/enriched-base-granules): Fortified mineral carrier for high-potency fertilizer formulations.
- [Other Nutrients Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/other-nutrients-base-granules): Specialized micronutrient-tailored carriers for zinc, boron, and sulfur formulations.
- [Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/base-granules): Universal high-hardness granule carrier platform for fertilizer blenders.
- [Plant Available Silica](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/plant-available-silica): Soluble silicon replenisher strengthening plant cell walls and biotic stress defense.
- [Diatomite Silicon](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/diatomite-silicon): Natural amorphous silica granules enhancing soil moisture retention and pest resistance.

## Manufacturing Services

- [Granule Technology](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/granule-technology): High-precision granulation engineering, rotary drum granulators, and uniform particle sizing.
- [Infrastructure Leasing](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/infrastructure-leasing): ISO-certified manufacturing capacity leasing for expanding agri-input brands.
- [Custom Packaging Solutions](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/custom-packaging-solutions): Complete private label packaging, automated bagging, and moisture-proof packing.
- [Job Work Services](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/job-work-services): Contract fertilizer manufacturing with strict quality assurance and high throughput.
- [Warehouse & Storage](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/warehouse-storage): Large-capacity covered storage, inventory management, and pan-India dispatch logistics.
